title: The total points back

aliases.name: R35 Flow -> the total -> a pointer back

members.role: the headline total is written by the hand at its own bar on its word, the total named under it - the bar's printed number hands over in place (R26-284)
on the sentence that says how big, a curved leader arcs from the written total back to the small bar's printed value, rings it, and the multiple the page computes pops on the arc

does: A headline total is written at its bar, then a curved leader arcs from it back to the small number it dwarfs, rings that number and puts the page's own multiple on the arc.

use_when.act: TURNS - a total read against the number it dwarfs (BRAVOS-USE-WHEN R35)
use_when.shape: series -> one number: two bars (or data) on one scale, one of them the total the sentence says, both sourced
use_when.use: a headline total, then a leader back to the bar it dwarfs, then the multiple (H row 16: 'a hundred and fifty' written at 2026E's bar, then on 'It is big enough' the leader back to the 2020-24 year's $28B, 5.4x on the arc; the AMD RFSoC page: the list price back to the board it dwarfs)
use_when.dont: the total competes with the data (P STK) - the arc and its multiple clear the page's words, and an authored bend through them is WARNed; a multiple typed rather than computed (E28); an end on a CLAIM bar with a label that does not say whose (P73 T1); a dock as the source (a card joins its datum by park_at)

source: P72 T53 (h) (harvest v2 R35; STK 0:02-0:10: '$12,000,000,000' arcs to the ringed peak, then the peak arcs back to the small bar with '10x' on the arc); P71 T35 stopped it for want of a leader (R26-414 (a)); proved as a private test-bed beat by projects/_proofs/p71-recipes/proof_t35.py on Steel and Paper H row 16 ('Between 2020 and 2024 ... big enough to bend the bond market', take 256.48 s) on the dossier's own three bars (EVIDENCE-DOSSIER.md C1), every value read off ev-debt-issuance-line-v1 - the figure on 'a hundred and fifty' (267.32), the leader on 'It is big enough' (272.30), 150 / 28 -> 5.4x written by the compiler; no approved cut carries it
